units.source_text: 此间不曾准备犒赏品，便派人到大堰邸内去取，

en.t: Since no reward gifts had been prepared here, he sent someone to the Oi residence to fetch them,

units.source_text: 嘱咐明石姬：不须特别丰盛。

en.t: and instructed Lady Akashi that they need not be especially lavish.

units.source_text: 明石姬即将手头现成之物交使者送上，计有衣箱两担。

en.t: Lady Akashi at once gave the messenger what she had ready at hand and sent it over, amounting to two loads of clothing boxes.

units.source_text: 钦差藏人弁急欲返宫，源氏内大臣便从衣箱中取出女装一袭，赠与钦差，并答诗云：

en.t: As the imperial envoy, the Chamberlain Ben, was eager to return to the palace, Genji the Minister of the Interior took a set of women's robes from the clothing boxes, presented it to the envoy, and composed this reply poem:
